chunks.sanskrit: sma̠yākā̠ vai nāmai̠te tath sma̠yākā̍nāgͫͫ smayāka̠tvam|
te de̠vā a̠śvinā̍vabruvann bhi̠ṣajau̠ vai sthaḥ̍|
ho̠ta̠vya̍m dīkhṣi̠tasya̍ gṛ̠hā(3) i na ho̍ta̠vyā(3) miti̍|
tejo̠ vai veṇuḥ̍ teja̍sai̠va ya̠jñasya̠ śiraḥ̠ sambha̍rati|

ma̠khāya̍ tvā ma̠khasya̍ tvā śī̠rṣṇa ityā̍ha|
e̠bhya e̠va lo̠kebhyo̍ ya̠jñasya̠ śiraḥ̠ sambha̍rati|
ūrja̠vm̐vā e̠tagͫ rasa̍m pṛthi̠vyā u̍pa̠dīkā̠ uddi̍hanti yadva̠lmīka̎m|
ya e̠va rasaḥ̍ pa̠śūn prāvi̍śat tame̠vāva̍rundhe|
apa̍dyamānaḥ pṛthi̠vyāmāśā̠ diśa̠ āpṛ̠ṇetyā̍ha tasmā̍da̠gniḥ sarvā̠ diśo'nu̠ vibhā̍ti|
ṛ̠jave̎ tvā sā̠dhave̎ tvā sukhṣi̠tyai tvā̠ bhūtyai̠ tvetyā̍ha|
atha̍ ka̠thā hotā̠ yaja̍mānāyā̠śiṣo̠ nāśā̎sta̠ iti̍|
sū̠pa̠sadā̍ me bhūyā̠ mā mā̍ higͫsī̠rityā̠hāhi̍gͫsāyai|
tasya̍ ma̠ruto̍ ra̠śmayaḥ̍ svāhā̍ ma̠rudbhiḥ̠ pari̍śraya̠svetyā̍ha|

e̠tāgͫ ha̠ vā a̍syo̠grade̍vo̠ rāja̍ni̠rāca̍krāma tato̠ vai sa du̠ścarmā̍'bhavat|
tasmā̠t triḥ pa̠rītya̠ na ca̍tu̠rtham parī̍yāt|
indra̍ e̠vaina̍gͫ ru̠drairda̍khṣiṇa̠to ro̍cayati̠ traiṣṭu̍bhena̠ chanda̍sā|
varu̍ṇa e̠vaina̍mādi̠tyaiḥ pa̠ścādro̍cayati̠ jāga̍tena̠ chanda̍sā sa mā̍ ruci̠to ro̍ca̠yetyā̍ha|
dyu̠tā̠na e̠vaina̍m māru̠to ma̠rudbhi̍ruttara̠to ro̍caya̠tyānu̍ṣṭubhena̠ chanda̍sā|
samrā̎ḍ gharma ruci̠tastvan de̠veṣvāyu̍ṣmāgͫͫ steja̠svī bra̍hmavarca̠sya̍sītyā̍ha|
ru̠ci̠ta e̠vaiṣa ma̍nu̠ṣye̎ṣvāyu̍ṣmāgͫͫ steja̠svī bra̍hmavarca̠sī bha̍vati|
ruga̍si̠ ruca̠m mayi̍ dhehi̠ mayi̠ rugityā̍ha|
ṣaḍvā ṛ̠tavaḥ̍ ṛ̠tubhya̍ e̠va ya̠jñasya̠ śiro'va̍rundhe|
vi̠śva̠jiti̠ sarva̍pṛṣṭhe̠ pravṛ̍ṇakti pṛ̠ṣṭhāni̠ vā acyu̍tañcyāvayanti|
ā ca̠ hye̍ṣa parā̍ ca pa̠thibhi̠ścara̍ti|
sa̠ddhrīcī̎śca̠ hye̍ṣa viṣū̍cīśca̠ vasā̍naḥ pra̠jā a̠bhi vi̠paśya̍ti|

pau̠ṣṇā vai de̠vata̍yā pa̠śavaḥ̍ svayai̠vaina̍m de̠vata̍yo̠pāva̍sṛjati|
usra̍ gha̠rmagͫ śi̠g̠ͫṣosra̍ gha̠rmam pā̍hi gha̠rmāya̍ śi̠g̠ͫṣetyā̍ha|
a̠śvibhyā̎m pinvasva̠ sara̍svatyai pinvasva pū̠ṣṇe pi̍nvasva̠ bṛha̠spata̍ye pinva̠svetyā̍ha|
atho̍ a̠śvinā̍ve̠va bhā̍ga̠dheye̍na̠ sama̍rddhayati gha̠rmam pā̍ta vasavo̠ yaja̍tā̠ vaḍityā̍ha|
na ya̠jñagͫ rakhṣā̍gͫsi ghnanti svāhā̎ tvā̠ sūrya̍sya ra̠śmaye̍ vṛṣṭi̠vana̍ye juho̠mītyā̍ha|

a̠gnirjyoti̠rjyoti̍ra̠gniḥ svāhā̠ sūryo̠ jyoti̠rjyotiḥ̠ sūryaḥ̠ svāhetyā̍ha|
ho̠ta̠vya̍magniho̠trā(3) nna ho̍ta̠vyā(3) miti̍ yadyaju̍ṣā juhu̠yāt|

gharma̠ yā te̍ di̠vi śugiti̍ ti̠sra āhu̍tīrjuhoti|

apa̠ dveṣo̠ apa̠ hvara̠ ityā̍ha̠ bhrātṛ̍vyāpanuttyai|

pari̠ vai tāgͫ samā̎m pra̠jā vayā̍gͫͫsyāsate tasmā̍duttarave̠dyāme̠vodvā̍sayet|

bra̠hma̠vā̠dino̍ vadanti yo vai vasī̍yāgͫ saym̐yathānā̠mamu̍pa̠cara̍ti|
